title: Dirty Frame
description: A dirty frame in dirty frame cinematography lets out-of-focus shoulders, glass, foliage, or crowd chew the edges of the picture so the aperture is occupied. The camera sits inside a populated space, not on a seamless studio axis.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Dirty versus clean edges is a moral diagram. Clean edges say the picture was granted.
Dirty edges say it was stolen, crowded, or survived. A shoulder in the foreground, a plant slicing a corner, rain on a window: someone else owns the near space.
It is the wrong tool for a product, a formal portrait, or a ritual altar. If the edges are dirty because the set was not cleared, you have clutter, not voyeur layers.
A dirty frame can still be composed. The chew should be intentional shapes, not a boom or a coffee cup.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Put matter close to the four edges or to the ones that should feel occupied. Open the aperture so that matter melts, unless a sharp shoulder is the eavesdropper.
A longer lens compresses crowd into the edges. A wider lens needs objects truly near the glass.
Check that faces still clear a hole in the middle. Prompt: Dirty frame around [Subject], out-of-focus shoulders, glass, foliage, or crowd chewing the edges, voyeur layers.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it for surveillance, parties, streets, and any view that should feel unauthorized or crowded. Do not dirty a ceremonial single or a product hold.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: Foreground Interest is a salient near object that may sit in one region. Dirty frame is specifically about edges being occupied, often all around.
Frame within Frame cuts a hard inner rectangle. Dirty matter is usually soft and irregular.
Voyeur is the concealment position that often produces dirty edges. Clean Frame is the opposite ethic: empty edges, isolation by tidiness.
Layered Depth may keep those edge layers sharp if they carry action.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: The Conversation watches through crowds, glass, and occupied space so privacy is already compromised. Children of Men keeps debris, bodies, and near matter in the aperture so the future never grants a poster.
Grammar of occupancy, not a blur sticker.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Occupy the edges and name the matter. Dirty frame around [Subject], out-of-focus shoulders, glass, foliage, or crowd chewing the edges, voyeur layers.
Say which edges (left shoulder, bottom foliage, rain-streaked glass). Keep a readable hole for the subject.
Forbid clean margins.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is accidental clutter, or a Clean Frame with a fake vignette. The tell is a boom, a logo, or a blurry oval that is not an object.
The fix is to choose the occluders, place them on the edges, and open the lens so they melt without covering the mouth.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is a dirty frame in film?

Out-of-focus or near matter chews the edges: shoulders, glass, foliage, crowd. The view is occupied. The camera feels inside a space we were not invited to stand in, or inside a crowd that will not clear.
Dirty Frame vs Clean Frame

A dirty frame occupies the edges. A clean frame keeps them empty of accident. One isolates by obstruction and complicity. The other isolates by tidiness. Choose the ethic. Do not mix them by forgetting to clear a table.
When should I use a dirty frame?
Use it when the view should feel stolen, crowded, or physically situated: surveillance, parties, streets, affairs. Do not use it on a formal altar or a product.
How do I prompt dirty frame for AI image or video?

Name the occluders and the edges. Example: Dirty frame around [Subject], out-of-focus shoulders, glass, foliage, or crowd chewing the edges, voyeur layers. Models default to clean margins. You must demand occupied edges.
